blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Sophie works on the accounting team at Czarnikow. Today she helps a new trainee. The topic is "Yesterday's Payments". Sophie uses short and simple sentences, because the trainee is new.

"Yesterday there were three payments," Sophie says. "One was late, but two were on time. Now they are all correct. The report is ready for your signature."

Sophie is calm and kind. She says, "One careful step at a time. That is how good accountants work." The trainee smiles. Yesterday's numbers were a little hard, but today they are clear.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "Sophie works on the accounting team at Czarnikow."

items.q: How many payments were there yesterday?
items.why: "Yesterday there were three payments."

items.q: How many payments were on time?
items.why: "One was late, but two were on time."

items.q: The text suggests that Sophie is…
items.why: Inferência: ela usa frases simples, é calma e encoraja o trainee — é paciente e prestativa.

items.q: What does "One careful step at a time" suggest about learning here?
options: It is better to go slowly and carefully
items.why: Inferência: a frase sugere um ritmo calmo e cuidadoso, um passo de cada vez.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falar com o novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. My name is Sophie. Today we look at yesterday's payments. Do not worry — the sentences are short and simple.

Yesterday I was here at eight. The office was quiet. There were four payments on my list. Three were correct, but one was wrong. So I called the bank.

The person on the phone was very kind. In ten minutes the payment was correct again. Now the report is ready. It is ready for your signature.

Yesterday was a busy day, but a good day. The numbers were clear at the end. That is what we want — clear and honest numbers.

Take your time. One careful step at a time. You can do it. Are you ready for the next payment?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time was Sophie in the office yesterday?
items.why: "Yesterday I was here at eight."

items.q: How many payments were on Sophie's list?
items.why: "There were four payments on my list."

items.q: What did Sophie do when one payment was wrong?
items.why: "So I called the bank."

items.q: The audio suggests that Sophie wants the trainee to feel…
items.why: Inferência: "Do not worry", "Take your time", "You can do it" — ela quer o trainee calmo e confiante.

items.q: Why does Sophie say the numbers were "clear at the end"?
items.why: Inferência: a payment errada foi corrigida, então no fim tudo ficou claro e certo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We checked the payments yesterday." Yesterday means…
items.why: Yesterday = ontem, o dia antes de hoje.

items.q: "The report is ready for your signature." Ready means…
items.why: Ready = pronto, preparado.

items.q: "One payment was late." Late means…
items.why: Late = atrasado, não no horário.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The numbers were ___, so we did not change them."
items.why: Correct = correto; se estão certos, não é preciso mudar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This number is ___. Please check it again."
items.why: Wrong = errado; por isso é preciso checar de novo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que você ouve no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you sign off on this report?" To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "I will check over the numbers before lunch." To check over means to…
items.why: Check over = revisar, olhar com cuidado.

items.q: "Please hand in the report today." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar.

items.q: "The payment was wrong, so I need to follow up with the bank." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar sequência, checar de novo e agir.

items.q: "Let's catch up tomorrow about yesterday's payments." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar a conversa em dia, conversar sobre novidades.
